_comment: INTERMEZZO — the doorframe between nice_ron and essay-1 (the agar lab). The line that used to ride nice_ron's long exhale, given a room of its own. No drum: nice_ron's belltale rings on in A minor (the forest bells follow you in — the fromforest shape), the sighing line speaks over it, then a soft A-minor pad resolves onto agar-lab's opening A ([a2,c3,e3]) and fades. One voice line, sized to its clip (reused from nice_ron line-02, no re-render).

sections.label: the doorframe — the forest bells ring on, in A minor now
but all good things must come to an end
toward the lab — the pad settles onto A, the agar is warming
